4. API reference
item.description: Every route with an example. For reading and one-off calls; running the whole folder changes data.

item.name: Health and sign-in
item.description: Public health check, sign-in settings and the signed-in session.

request.description: **No token.** Answers {"status":"ok","version":...} once the app is up. No token. Used by the platform probe.
**Public.** Tenant id, client id, scope and authority the browser needs to sign in. Public by design; holds no secret and no data.
**Member.** The signed-in user as the API sees them: id, name, email and role (admin or member), read from the token on this request.
**Member.** Everything the main screen shows: settings, connections (never keys), references summary, recent invoices and exports.
**Member.** Invoices queued and being read on this instance, and how many it admits.

**Member.** Reads the database and lists the evidence container once each, through the private endpoints when they are locked down. 200 with ok for each, or 503 with the failed one; never an address or message.

item.name: Processing plan and upload
item.description: Every upload runs under a processing plan the same person previewed and confirmed: preflight, confirm, then upload each file named in the plan.

request.description: **Member.** Send the options and the name and size of every file. Returns a plan token, a summary and warnings. Up to 500 files of up to 12 MB each.
**Member.** Confirms the previewed plan. Only the account that made the plan can confirm it.
**Member.** Extends a confirmed plan by 10 minutes while a long batch is still uploading.

**Member.** Multipart form: file, options (the same JSON as the plan) and preflight_token. The file must be named in the confirmed plan with the same size. PDF, PNG, JPEG, TIFF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV or text; 12 MB at most. Returns the invoice record; reading continues in the background.

item.name: Invoices
item.description: Read one invoice, its source document, audit trail and target check.

request.description: **Member.** Status (queued, processing, needs_review, ready, exported, error), extracted fields, lines, checks and the reader trace.
**Member.** The original file, served with its own content type, nosniff and a sandboxing CSP.
**Member.** Every step recorded for this invoice: upload hash, reads, edits, approvals, exports.
**Member.** Read-only: the invoice's target-sheet cells by status, with evidence and row checks.
**Member.** Confirm-time accuracy against owner truth, per field. Optional ?supplier=.

item.name: Review and export
item.description: Review edits, retry, approve and export one invoice.

request.description: **Member.** Saves edited fields and lines for the given revision; confirm:true approves. A stale revision is refused with 409; a control character or another a workbook cannot hold with 400 (a value read from a document is cleaned instead).
**Member.** Reads the invoice again under a new confirmed plan.

**Member.** Creates the Excel export for an invoice at the given revision: the three template sheets with what was found, blanks blank. Open validation and review holds do not block it (owner decision D11); the receipt records them as open_holds. A duplicate is the same number from the same supplier site; with a site or number blank nothing can be called one, so the invoice exports. It gets the hold Possible Duplicate, listed first and naming the match, which a review confirm does not clear, when the same file or (a site missing on either side) the same number was already exported: export anyway or delete. Until the original exports the copy can read as approved. A held invoice records no receipt allocations, so a false positive (a different supplier's same number) leaves its quantities uncounted in later receipt checks. A re-scan with no number cannot be noticed. 409 only if it is still processing, not read, changed or a duplicate; an invoice already exported returns its existing export.
**Member.** Downloads what was read, before validation, as Excel. Needs acknowledge_unvalidated.
**Member.** Builds a target workbook from hand-entered Header, Tax_Breakdown and Details. Never approves.

item.name: Exports and downloads
item.description: Download exports and batch workbooks; long downloads run in the background.

request.description: **Member.** The export workbook.
**Member.** The evidence record behind an export: sources, hashes, approvals.

**Member.** One workbook for several invoices; each item names the invoice and its revision. Holds do not block (owner decision D11): each invoice is written with what was found, blanks blank, and its receipt records the open holds for the export team to validate by hand. All or nothing on integrity: an invoice still processing or not read, changed, already exported or duplicated refuses the batch with 409. The workbook holds only the Header, Tax_Breakdown and Details sheets, Transaction Number 1..n (no Checks sheet).

**Member.** Read-only. Splits the selected invoices into ready (in transaction order, each with attention: the holds still open on it, information only since D11; status: its rules status; blank_fields: the empty cells its row in the workbook would hold, not counting the Ref No., Comment and default-mode UPC cells that are empty by owner rule; line_count: the lines the workbook would hold) and blocked, each blocked one with its reasons as code and message (Processing, Not Read, Changed, Exported, Duplicate). Possible Duplicate is a hold, so it shows under attention, not blocked; see Export one invoice. Send the ready ones to /api/exports/batch.
**Member.** The batch workbook.
**Member.** What was read for several invoices, before validation.

**Member.** The draft of everything: the target workbook for all selected invoices, held ones included, with the Checks sheet. Marked DRAFT in the file name and on every sheet (red tab and header row, a note on A1, the printed header); sheet names and headers stay the template's. Never an export.
**Member.** kind is target-draft, extraction-batch, export-check, export-batch, fine-rules-target or fine-rules-review; the body is that download's body. Returns a task id to poll.
**Member.** Running, or the finished file. Only the account that started it can read it.

item.description: Mapping-table driven checks, review and target workbooks.

request.description: **Member.** The active mapping-table configuration.
**Admin.** Replaces the configuration (JSON object). Audited by field names and sizes, never values.
**Member.** Runs the rules over invoices.
**Member.** The rule findings as Excel.
**Member.** The target workbook after the rules.
**Member.** Corrections sent by reviewers.
**Member.** A reviewer's correction to a rule outcome, with evidence.
**Admin.** Admin accepts or rejects a correction.
**Member.** Whether the AI rules assistant is on and, if not, why.
**Admin.** Admin check of the Azure AI Foundry connection; the assistant stays off until it passes.

request.description: **Member.** Ranked item master rows for a code or description. No AI call.
**Member.** Why an invoice line matched an item master row or not, from the engine's facts.
**Member.** Drafts rule rows for a line and logs them as Proposed rule feedback; an admin decides.
**Member.** Which UPC column the target export fills.
**Admin.** Admin sets the UPC column.

**Member.** Ranked item-master candidates for an invoice line.

request.description: **Member.** Layouts learned so far.

**Admin.** Admin removes a layout.

item.description: Synthetic sample files for training and tests.

request.description: **Member.** Synthetic reference data.
**Member.** A synthetic invoice.

item.name: Item master and mapping tables
item.description: Admin uploads of the owner's master data, with validation, activation and rollback.

request.description: **Admin.** Uploaded and active item-master versions.
**Admin.** Multipart file upload; validates without activating.
**Admin.** Makes a validated upload the active version.
**Admin.** Returns to an earlier version; ?expected_signature= guards against a concurrent change.
**Admin.** Removes a validated upload that was never activated.
**Admin.** Re-matches every open (not exported) invoice against the live item master in the background; activate and rollback start this too.
**Admin.** The latest re-match: status, counts and, per changed invoice, the lines newly matched, lost or changed.
**Admin.** Uploaded and active mapping-table versions.
**Admin.** Multipart file upload; validates without activating.
**Admin.** Makes a validated upload active.
**Admin.** Returns to an earlier version.
**Admin.** The active workbook.

item.name: Reference data and policy
item.description: Admin setup: references, supplier templates, tolerances.

request.description: **Admin.** Multipart file upload of the reference workbook.
**Admin.** Synthetic references.
**Admin.** Reads the synthetic invoice under a confirmed plan.
**Admin.** Multipart upload of an invoice2data YAML template.
**Admin.** Price and total tolerances and currency decimals. Marks unexported invoices for review again.

item.name: AI connection and settings
item.description: Admin control of AI. The Azure deployment allows Azure AI Foundry only (INV_STUDIO_AI_PROVIDERS=azure); other providers answer 403.

request.description: **Admin.** Default provider and model, and the AI on/off switch (ai_fallback). With it off the server refuses every AI read.
**Member.** The rules the AI added, each with its source, reason, model, file and the lines it has filled. There is no approval step.

item.name: Remove a rule the AI added

request.description: **Admin.** Removes one rule the AI added, so it fills nothing more. Audited.

**Admin.** Endpoint (an Azure resource host or Foundry project), agent or deployment name, and an api-key or managed identity. Makes a real call first: only a completed answer saves it, stored encrypted; a failed test saves nothing and keeps the previous connection.
**Admin.** Removes the saved connection.
**Admin.** Refused with 403 on the Azure deployment.
**Admin.** Removes a saved key.
**Admin.** Models of a connected provider. 403 for a provider the deployment does not allow.
**Admin.** Local installs only in practice; 403 on the Azure deployment.
**Admin.** Removes it.
**Admin.** Refused in the cloud build.
**Admin.** 403 on the Azure deployment.
**Admin.** Refused in the cloud build.
**Admin.** 403 on the Azure deployment.
**Admin.** Removes it.

**Admin.** Permanently deletes invoices and their files. Each item names the invoice and its current revision; needs confirm_permanent: true (a boolean). For an exported invoice a minimal record stays so it is still noticed if sent again: its key, line quantities, the file's SHA-256 and its invoice number.
**Admin.** Daily and month-to-date AI spend. ?days=30.
**Admin.** Everyone who has signed in, their role and last sign-in. Read-only: roles are granted in Entra ID.
